issues.description: The problem statement shows the build_msd_circ parameter y_states typed as tuple[int], while the template and reference solution use a list[int] for y_states. This small type/annotation mismatch could confuse students about whether to pass a tuple or list and which type the provided tests expect.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type annotation consistent across artifacts. Update the problem statement to use y_states: list[int] (or change the template and solution annotations to tuple[int]) and clarify that either an iterable of ints is acceptable. Ensure examples and tests use the same type.

issues.description: The resource state is referred to as '|Y>' throughout the problem statement and the API (e.g. make_y_state), but in the solution implementation's make_y_state function comment it is called the 'S state'. This introduces an inconsistent name for the same conceptual entity (the |Y> state = S|+>), which can confuse students mapping the problem description to the implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Use a consistent name for the resource state across all artifacts. Update the solution comment (and any other comments) to call the prepared state '|Y>' (or 'Y state (S|+>)') so it matches the function name make_y_state and the problem statement.
